project_type: Monorepo: Go engine (net/http stdlib) + Strapi CMS TypeScript plugin
build_system: Go modules for engine, npm for CMS. Engine has no workspace; CMS is standard Strapi plugin structure.
build_command: Engine: `cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/test-connection/engine && go build ./...`; CMS: `cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/test-connection/cms && npx tsc --noEmit`
test_command: Engine: `cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/test-connection/engine && go test ./...`; CMS: `cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/test-connection/cms && npm run test -- --run`
verification_instructions: 1. Run engine build+test: `cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/test-connection/engine && go build ./... && go test ./...`. 2. Run CMS typecheck+test: `cd /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/test-connection/cms && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run test -- --run`.
environment_constraints: All work happens in worktree at /home/nuzirwan/project/rule-engine-api/.worktrees/test-connection. Use `git -C <worktree>` for git commands.
contribution_requirements: CMS stores secretRef (never actual secrets). Engine resolves secrets via SecretProvider at runtime. Test Connection password is passed in request body, used once, then discarded.

key_patterns.engine_admin_handler: Admin handlers in engine/internal/httpapi/admin_handlers.go follow pattern: decode JSON with decodeJSON(), validate, call store method, call writeJSON() for response. Use a.fail(w, ctx, label, err) for errors.
key_patterns.engine_admin_routes: Routes registered in admin.go mount() using Go 1.22 method-aware patterns like `mux.Handle("POST /admin/...", h(handler))`
key_patterns.connector_open_pattern: Connectors in engine/internal/connect/drivers/ implement Connector.Open(ctx, def) -> Client. Password injected via connect.WithSecret(ctx, secret) and read via connect.SecretFrom(ctx).
key_patterns.connector_health_check: Health check is Execute(ctx, Operation{Kind: "ping"}). Postgres does pool.Ping(), MySQL does db.PingContext(), Valkey does client.Do("PING").
key_patterns.cms_controller_pattern: Controllers in cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/controllers/ use factory pattern returning object with handlers. Handlers receive ctx with status/body properties.
key_patterns.cms_proxy_pattern: Controllers create AdminClient from resolveAdminConfig(), call engine endpoint, handle AdminApiError for error classification.
key_patterns.cms_routes: Routes defined in cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/routes/index.ts using { method, path, handler } pattern.
key_patterns.cms_modal_pattern: Modals use @strapi/design-system Dialog.Root/Content/Header/Body/Footer. State tracked via React useState with mode/formData/errors/isSubmitting. See EnvironmentManager for test connection modal pattern.
key_patterns.cms_types: Engine API types in cms/types/engine.ts. Add new request/response types there.
key_patterns.admin_client: AdminClient in cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/src/services/admin-client.ts wraps engine admin API. Add new methods following existing patterns.
